content: framer-motion rebranded to Motion (npm package 'motion', import from motion/react) in 2024-2025; framer-motion npm package still maintained as compat re-export, both currently at v13.1.0, identical API. Motion supports orchestrated stagger via transition:{when,delayChildren:stagger(n)}, layout animations via layout/layout=position prop, AnimatePresence for exit transitions, and whileInView/useInView for scroll-triggered reveals -- covers all orchestration needs (staggered KPI reveals, nav transitions, panel enter/exit) without a new library.
